description: Test file for the 'config' package, containing unit tests for configuration desanitization, locale fixing, DSN detection, JSON map validation, and equality checks.

methods.name: TestDesanitize
methods.description: Unit test for the desanitize function, verifying that sensitive config fields are correctly desanitized without altering the source config.

methods.name: TestFixInvalidLocales
methods.description: Unit test for fixing invalid locale settings in the configuration, ensuring defaults are applied and locales are correctly validated and updated.

methods.name: TestIsDatabaseDSN
methods.description: Unit test for detecting whether a given DSN string is a database connection string, covering various URL and path formats.

methods.name: TestIsJSONMap
methods.description: Unit test for validating whether a byte array contains a JSON object map, testing valid, invalid, and edge cases.

methods.name: TestEqual
methods.description: Unit test for comparing configuration objects for equality, including cases with no differences and with intentional differences.
